overview_description.description:
LUS Brands tackles the $50B+ global curly hair market. LUS bootstrapped its way to over $1M in sales and 19K+ customers in its first year.

Launched in 2017 as a direct-to-consumer e-commerce brand, LUS offers products for different curl types which can be purchased on a one-time or subscription basis.

about_short_description.short_description: LUS makes haircare products for curly hair.

product.name: 3-Step System
product.description: A haircare routine system consisting of cleansing, conditioning, and styling products tailored for different curl types.

product.name: Black Label Collection
product.description: A set of complementary haircare products designed to address specific hair concerns and enhance the 3-Step System.

product.name: Exfoliating Scalp Scrub
product.description: A product designed to exfoliate and cleanse the scalp to remove buildup and promote scalp health.

product.name: Healthy Scalp Serum
product.description: A serum formulated to nourish and improve the health of the scalp.

product.name: Split End Mender
product.description: A treatment product aimed at repairing and reducing the appearance of split ends in hair.

product.name: Irish Sea Moss Gel
product.description: A styling gel made with Irish sea moss to support curl health and provide hold for curly hair.
